title: SB2206 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13, relative to firearms.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2024-01-31; crossfiled twin https://www.capitol.tn.gov/Bills/113/Bill/HB2680.pdf is the same printed document (it names SENATE BILL 2206); copied from TN-HB-2680-2023.draft.txt)
provenance.note: Draft as filed, 2024-01-30/31; shared document with HB 2680. Deletes 39-17-1307(g) (the lawful-handgun-carry exception) and a cross-reference in 39-17-1313(a); no new words are added. Effective July 1, 2024.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 39-17-1307): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1307, is amended by deleting subsection (g).
SECTION 2 (TCA 39-17-1313(a)): Tennessee Code Annotated, Section 39-17-1313(a), is amended by deleting "or who lawfully carries a handgun pursuant to § 39-17-1307(g)".
